speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: This can be then handed over to the collection points which will be established and can help the organisers gauge the requirements for planning subsequent years’ NDP shows.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I at least ask whether we can do away with the plastic bottle?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Two, we have this Clean and Green message that we issue almost throughout the year that people should bring their own reusable bottles but, all of a sudden at the NDP, that message disappears.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, I am just hoping for NDP 2020, we can do away with the plastic bottle.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: And, two, can we then issue the message out to urge people to bring their reusable bottles to NDP?

speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
text: First of all, I think it is important for us to establish that we are actually on the same side, namely, that we agree with the Member, together with many outside this Chamber, who believe that we should all be more active in terms of understanding the importance of saving the environment and also each of us doing our part and, within established events, including the NDP, what more can be done.

speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
text: The fact that the NDP shows do take a number of hours and it is held in the afternoon, so one can expect sunny weather most of the time, we do have to cater water for people to drink.

speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
text: What happened in past years was that there were actually two bottles of water in each funpack.

speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
text: So, it is actually a combination of efforts like that.

speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
text: The rest of the plastic that we managed to save from being put into the funpacks include, for example, the second water bottle that we did not put in, as well as we changed the plastic clappers and also took away the plastic flag stands.

speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
text: So, what we will do is for future shows, for example, the NDP that is coming next year and the year after and so on, we will continue these efforts.

speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
text: We will take in seriously the feedback and suggestions from the Member and others in this area to see how we can further reinforce, both in terms of the education message to call on all of us individually also, and beyond NDP shows, in their day-to-day lives to also do the responsible thing and to minimise the use of such plastics.

speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
text: Besides the plastic bottle, there was also this single-use wrist band which only lights up at the venue but it is useless outside the event venue for NDP.

speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
text: So, perhaps there could be a collection point for everyone to drop it back so that we can recycle it?

speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
text: There were also trash bags provided within the funpack.

speaker: Mr Heng Chee How
text: Indeed, we encourage and would like to remind our spectators, as part of being environmentally conscious and trying to help, that all the items that they really do not need or do not want, to hand those in at these collection points.
